scenes.headline: How Nemotron trains in 4-bit without falling apart
scenes.sub: NVFP4: a 4-bit element, a shared scale, and three stabilizers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Shrimp! Most four-bit models are squeezed after training. NVIDIA's Nemotron trains its biggest matrix multiplies in four bits. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Train in 4-bit, not just serve in it: the heavy matrix multiplies run in NVFP4, forward and backward, while the model is still learning.
scenes.mark: while the model is still learning
scenes.say: The idea: don't quantize after training. Run the heavy matrix multiplies in four bits, forward and backward, while the model learns.

scenes.title: What one NVFP4 value costs
scenes.say: Four bits alone can't span the range, so NVFP4 splits the job.

parts.note: E2M1: a sign, 2 exponent bits, 1 mantissa bit
parts.say: Each value is a four-bit element: a sign, two exponent bits, one mantissa bit.

parts.note: one FP8 scale shared by 16 elements
parts.say: Every sixteen elements share an eight-bit scale, plus one for the tensor.

parts.note: with the range of roughly a 10-bit number
parts.say: Four and a half bits each, with a range closer to a ten-bit number.

steps.label: 2D blocks on the weights
steps.note: each scale fits the local structure
steps.say: One: quantize weights in two-dimensional blocks, so each shared scale fits the local structure and fewer values clip.

steps.label: Hadamard spreads the outliers
steps.note: on the weight-gradient inputs, undone afterwards
steps.say: Two: outliers poison the weight-gradient multiply, so a random Hadamard transform first spreads them across the block.

steps.label: Stochastic rounding on gradients
steps.say: Three: round gradients stochastically. It's unbiased on average, so small gradients aren't pushed toward zero.

scenes.title: Where the four bits actually go

steps.say: The model is a hybrid: Mamba-2 blocks, some attention, and expert layers. Five hundred fifty billion parameters, fifty-five billion active.

steps.note: NVFP4 here: the bulk of the FLOPs
steps.say: The expert layers carry most of the compute, and that's where the four-bit multiplies run.
Fragile parts stay at higher precision: embeddings, final layers, the prediction head, and Mamba and attention projections.

scenes.label: training-loss gap against a BF16 reference run
scenes.note: a loss gap, not benchmark parity; the run diverged twice
scenes.say: The result: a training-loss gap under zero point four percent. A loss gap, not benchmark parity, and the run diverged twice.

scenes.text: Native 4-bit training is about where you dare to put four bits, not making every tensor 4-bit.
scenes.mark: where you dare to put four bits
scenes.say: Native four-bit training is about where you dare to put four bits, not making every tensor four-bit.

recap: A 4-bit element, one scale per 16 values
4-bit experts, higher precision at the edges
scenes.say: To recap: small elements with shared scales, three gradient stabilizers, and four bits where the model can take it.
